design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (non-workflow; last task of the difficulty). Frozen 2026-09-17 14:05:00 EDT.
[Why a good test] Graham Kessler asks for one thing: add just enough from his money market for his 12-Month CD to get the jumbo rate when it renews. The number he needs is the jumbo shortfall on the principal reconciled from the ledger (deposit + compounded interest + reversals - withdrawals - penalties, excluding 11 interest payouts totalling 3535.17). Two hidden problems sit in front of it: a 58.73 penalty charged on the 6000.00 he took out on 2026-09-14 - four days after the 2026-09-10 maturity, inside the 10-day grace, although the entry was recorded early_partial - must be reversed first (policy: owed reversals are posted before the shortfall is measured), and the certificate's pay_to_checking disposition still names the Everyday Checking closed on 2026-08-05, which must be repointed before new grace money is added. The trap is that the penalty's rate (3.97) and days (90) match the tier, so a rate/days check finds nothing; only the date test against the grace window reveals the error.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal, cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction, cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate, cd_ext_term_add_on_amount, the workflow and its four tools. Claimed here (disjoint): cd_ext_grace_withdrawal_penalty_reversal (reverse_grace_penalty_e6d62385), cd_ext_interest_payout_repoint (update_interest_disposition_67b383bc), cd_ext_grace_jumbo_top_up (add_grace_deposit_522b16cc, owner user). Different policy cores: task 0 reverses a penalty at the wrong rate after grace, fixes the maturity instruction, books a renewal and a term add-on; task 1 works inside the grace window - a penalty on a grace withdrawal, the interest disposition, and a grace add-on sized to the jumbo threshold. Difficulty-level closure: 7 extended policies, all covered (task 0: 4, task 1: 3), one workflow claimed by task 0 only, 7 tools each used by exactly one task.
[Problem-tree card] Root cd_ext_grace_jumbo_top_up. Edge A root -> cd_ext_grace_withdrawal_penalty_reversal, value_input, gate 'reversals'; policy_source 'Every penalty reversal owed on the certificate is posted before the shortfall is measured, because a reversal credit is principal and the jumbo bonus is judged on principal.'; false at opening: penalty row posted 2026-09-14 (58.73), no reversal, principal 94226.61. Edge B root -> cd_ext_interest_payout_repoint, value_input, gate binding 'instructions_open' (the top-up is written only while the interest disposition names no closed payout account; declared in overwrite against the grace add-on sentence of cd_evt_maturity_and_grace); policy_source 'New money added during grace becomes principal on which the renewed term's interest is credited and paid out, so before it is added, a payout disposition that names a closed payout account is repointed to an open account of the owner.'; false at opening: interest_disposition pay_to_checking, payout = Everyday Checking status closed. Order: reversal, repoint, top-up (the two prerequisites are parallel; swapped order gives the same values and terminal DB - sens.py 1 swapped run True). Deletion sensitivity (sens.py 1): skip reversal -> top-up 5773.39 instead of 5714.66; skip repoint -> top-up 0 (instructions_open false) instead of 5714.66; skip top-up -> no deposit. The persona never names the penalty, reversal, disposition or payout account; tools validate nothing.
[Base-invariant card] cd_penalty_reversal: reverse_once satisfied (one penalty, no reversal). cd_update_instructions: payout_account_owned - the Interest Checking ending 4861 is the owner's and active. cd_deposit: concentration_cap (94285.34 + 5714.66 = 100000.00 << 2500000.00); cd_open_and_funding policy_scope (money market of the same owner); grace_window time gate - anchor maturity_date 2026-09-10, day 1 = 2026-09-11, allowed through 2026-09-20 inclusive; frozen 2026-09-17 is day 7 (positive case 2026-09-20, negative 2026-09-21); active_for_add_on ('A term add-on is allowed only while the certificate's status is active.') is a base gate the blueprint applies to every cd_deposit; its condition speaks only of term add-ons, and this deposit is a grace add-on (deposit_kind grace_add_on) on a grace_period certificate, so the gate places no condition on it. The solvability ledger lists it because the gate script requires every gate on the subject; 'satisfied' there means 'does not block this write', not that the certificate is active. The grace withdrawal is judged by base cd_evt_maturity_and_grace 'A grace withdrawal is kind grace_period and carries no penalty.'
[Business-object card] One certificate (ending 4092). Penalty object: the single cd_penalty row, source_item_id = the 2026-09-14 withdrawal whose counterparty is the owner's Interest Checking; the reversal points at the penalty row. Principal includes the opening 99850.00, compounded 337.22 (Aug 2026, after the Everyday Checking closed) and 98.12 (maturity), the withdrawal and penalty, plus the reversal after step 7; excludes 11 payouts Sep 2025 - Jul 2026. Funding: Money Market Account ending 5174, 7420.66.
[Seed rows] customer (Graham Kessler, 8645550152 / 1959-11-03 / 5306, band-conform); Interest Checking ending 4861 active (receives the withdrawal; replacement payout account; relationship tier); Everyday Checking ending 5528 closed 2026-08-05 (the stale payout account; removing it removes edge B); Money Market Account ending 5174 (funding; removing it zeroes the top-up); certificate; 16 ledger rows (1 opening deposit, 11 interest payouts, 2 compounded credits, 1 withdrawal, 1 penalty). No row ignites an obligation outside the task: the renewal is not yet due (grace open through 2026-09-20).
[Persona] Brisk retired engineer. Volunteers only the goal and that he moves the money himself. On request: credentials, CD 4092, money market 5174, renew as the same 12-month CD. Passive: confirms the 6000.00 withdrawal only if raised; mentions the closed Everyday Checking and names the Interest Checking only if raised or asked; accepts a credited charge and a quoted amount; runs the handed-over deposit and hangs up once the money is in. Different voice and order from task 0.
[Standard solution and verification] find_customers(8645550152) -> verify (phone, DOB, SSN) -> find_cd_certificates -> find_cd_transactions -> find_checking_accounts -> find_savings_accounts -> reverse_grace_penalty (penalty row, 58.73) -> update_interest_disposition (pay_to_checking, Interest Checking) -> user add_grace_deposit (5714.66, pcb_savings, money market). python3 seed1.py seed1.json -> B_mat 100285.34, pen 58.73, principal 94226.61, after reversal 94285.34, need 5714.66, need without reversal 5773.39. check_compute --task 1 -> COMPUTE OK (3 comps, 29 factors, 8 history rows, 17 branches). Key computation cd_ext_grace_jumbo_top_up (15 bindings) has the untriggered raise-to-minimum branch; forcing the savings CFIELD off gives 0, zeroing the ledger sums gives 0 (principal 0 -> shortfall 100000.00 does not fit the money market).
[Easy mistakes] adding the payouts to principal (97820.51 -> shortfall 2179.49); reversing nothing because rate and days match; reversing after measuring (5773.39); repointing to the money market (not the same kind); using the term add-on route or waiting for renewal; topping up to more than the shortfall.
[Two-way sweep and draft] Every world-reading binding quotes its rule sentence (see compute_basis); each rule promise (grace-day window, source withdrawal named by the penalty, owner's withdrawal = own account or official check, single reversal per penalty, the payout-account carve-out for a payout maturity instruction, same-kind replacement and the other-kind fallback, grace window, same-tier renewal, jumbo/grace-add-on tier flags, the disposition gate instructions_open, five ledger sums, one-month grace add-on window, minimum raise, fits both rooms, never cut down) has a binding. Visible-context draft from the rules and reads gives 58.73 / Interest Checking / 5714.66, equal to gold.
[Revisions] 'bool' is not an allowed primitive -> rewrote taken_in_grace as (pen_date or '') != '' and ...; per-task gates: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

[Revisions round 2 - policy-task audit] T1-1/G5: the repoint edge bore no weight because the top-up compute never read the disposition. cd_ext_grace_jumbo_top_up now has bindings payout_status and instructions_open (a grace add-on is accepted only while the interest disposition names no closed payout account), declared in overwrite against base 'add funds where grace_add_on_allowed is true ...'; the edge is value_input on instructions_open. Re-run (sens.py 1): skip reversal 5773.39, skip repoint 0, gold 5714.66; swapped prerequisite order identical terminal DB; check_compute confirms both value_input edges change the root. G1: the grace reversal dedups per penalty. G3/O3: the owner's grace withdrawal now includes proceeds by official check, the destination and account are read from the withdrawal the penalty's source_item_id names, and the remaining exclusion (proceeds to an account not the owner's) is declared in overwrite against 'on a grace-period withdrawal'. O14: cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal carves out penalties on grace-period withdrawals, so only this policy reverses them. T1-O2: ledger count corrected to 16. T1-O3: the active_for_add_on wording above.
[Revisions round 3 - policy-task audit r2] Task 1 passed round 2; only charter wording it rests on changed: R2-O4 the reason in cd_ext_grace_jumbo_top_up now reads 'New money added during grace becomes principal on which the renewed term's interest is credited and paid out', tying the payout-account condition to the new principal (the prerequisite policy_source above was updated to the same text); R2-O3 the cd_ext_grace_withdrawal_penalty_reversal overwrite now carries both halves (owner's own withdrawal including official check, and the non-owner exclusion); R2-O5 an earlier penalty is stated to fall to cd_evt_penalty_reversal; R2-O6 a replacement payout account must match the kind of a payout disposition (not engaged here). No binding of P5, P6 or P7 changed; values 58.73 / Interest Checking / 5714.66 and skip values 5773.39 / 0 re-run unchanged. Persona/seed re-check: 8645550152 / 1959-11-03 / 5306, CD ending 4092 matured 2026-09-10 and set to auto_renew (the persona's 'is going to roll over'), money market ending 5174, the 6000.00 withdrawal to the Interest Checking ending 4861 on 2026-09-14, Everyday Checking closed 2026-08-05, interest paid to checking - all match initial_state.
[Revisions round 4 - policy-KB audit] D4: cd_ext_grace_jumbo_top_up declares in overwrite that the shortfall uses the ledger-reconciled principal instead of base's recorded principal_balance, and says the reconciled figure governs where the two differ (here 94226.61 before and 94285.34 after the reversal, equal to the record). Prerequisite effect texts were reworded without field tokens. No binding changed; values 58.73 / Interest Checking / 5714.66 unchanged. Persona/seed re-checked: no persona line touched.
[Revisions round 5 - policy-KB re-audit] S3: the cd_ext_grace_jumbo_top_up replacement now adds 'This is the same reconciled principal on which the jumbo test of every renewal is judged', matching the charter-wide basis stated by cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate. S1/S2 do not touch this task's path. No binding, value, persona line or seed field changed; prerequisite quotations re-verified.
[Revisions round 6 - policy-task audit r5] Charter changes for R5-G1 (cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction deadline removed), O2b and R5-O1 (cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal current-term scope and full formula) do not touch this task's policies; cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal still writes nothing here (grace-dated penalty). Values 58.73 / Interest Checking / 5714.66 unchanged; no persona or seed change.
user_scenario:
You are Graham Kessler, a retired civil engineer and Army veteran in Greenville who talks in short, practical sentences and does not like to waste anyone's time. You start by saying your 12-month CD with Piedmont Crescent just matured and is going to roll over, that you heard the jumbo rate starts at a hundred thousand dollars, and that you want to put in just enough from your money market for the CD to get the jumbo rate when it renews - not a penny more than it needs. That is all you called about. The bank can handle its own side however it has to; you will move the money out of the money market yourself once the agent sets it up and tells you the amount.
You give details only when asked, a piece at a time: mobile number 8645550152, date of birth 1959-11-03, last four of your Social Security number 5306. If asked which CD, it is the one ending in 4092; if asked which money market, it ends in 5174. You do not remember the CD's balance to the dollar and tell the agent to go by the bank's records. If asked whether the CD should keep renewing as the same 12-month CD, you say yes.
Only if the agent brings up the money you took out of the CD this week do you confirm you moved six thousand dollars to your Interest Checking on the 14th for a roof deposit. Only if the agent brings up your old Everyday Checking do you say you closed it in August and everything goes to your Interest Checking ending in 4861 now; if asked where the CD's interest should be paid from now on, you say that same Interest Checking. If the agent says a charge is being credited back to the CD, you say fine, thank you. If the agent tells you an amount for the top-up, you accept it as long as it comes out of the money market.
When the agent hands you the deposit step, you carry it out with exactly the amount, the CD and the money market the agent gives you, and read back the confirmation. Once you hear the money is in the CD, you say thanks and hang up. If the agent says the money market cannot cover what is needed, you say you will think about it and hang up.
